Chat request with response_format json_object that returns valid JSON content

```zig title="Zig"
const std = @import("std");
const liter_llm = @import("liter_llm");

pub fn main() !void {
    const _api_key = std.c.getenv("API_KEY") orelse return error.MissingApiKey;
    var _client = try liter_llm.create_client(std.mem.span(_api_key), null, null, null, null);
    defer _client.free();
    const _result_json = try _client.chat("{\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Respond with JSON only.\",\"role\":\"system\"},{\"content\":\"Give me a user object with name and age fields.\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"gpt-4\",\"response_format\":{\"type\":\"json_object\"}}");
    defer std.heap.c_allocator.free(_result_json);
    std.debug.print("{s}\n", .{_result_json});

}
```
